name: ac-climate-and-transition-risk
description: Reading climate risk as an investment input rather than a declaration: emissions scopes and what each measures, disclosure regimes and their gaps, climate scenarios and the limits of their use, transition risk by sector and its timing, physical risk and location, stranded-asset arithmetic, carbon markets and price exposure, and the written climate record. It frames the measurement and the arithmetic; it never recommends a security and never predicts policy. Use when asking "scope 1 2 3 emissions", "climate disclosure", "transition risk", "physical risk", "stranded assets", "carbon price exposure", "climate scenario", "TCFD", "financed emissions". Not for the ESG scoring industry (ac-equity-research), not for commodity pricing as a market (ac-commodities-trading), not for infrastructure or real-asset valuation (ac-alternatives-and-real-assets).
